question: What oblation material produces the subjugation of the world?
premises: Lotus leaves may be used as oblation material
An oblation is to be offered with them
This oblation brings the world under control
inference: Offering an oblation with lotus leaves effects the subjugation of the world
uncertainties: homoyaṃ taken as fused form for homo+ayam
plain_english: Or one should offer an oblation with lotus leaves; this oblation brings the world under control.
